class.name: OcgXcafdocViewtool
class.brief_description: Provides tools to store and retrieve Views in and from TDocStd_Document Each View contains parts XCAFDoc_View attribute with all information about camera and view window. Also each view contain information of displayed shapes and GDTs as sets of shape and GDT labels.
class.description: ! Provides tools to store and retrieve Views ! in and from TDocStd_Document ! Each View contains parts XCAFDoc_View attribute ! with all information about camera and view window. ! Also each view contain information of displayed shapes and GDTs ! as sets of shape and GDT labels.

method.name: BaseLabel
method.description: Returns the label under which Views are stored

method.name: IsView
method.description: Returns True if label belongs to a View table and is a View definition

method.name: GetViewLabels
method.description: Returns a sequence of View labels currently stored in the View table

method.name: SetView_3
method.description: Sets a link with GUID

method.name: SetView_2
method.description: Sets a link with GUID

method.name: SetView_1
method.description: Sets a link with GUID

method.name: SetClippingPlanes
method.description: Set Clipping planes to given View

method.name: RemoveView
method.description: Remove View

method.name: GetViewLabelsForShape
method.description: Returns all View labels defined for label ShapeL

method.name: GetViewLabelsForGDT
method.description: Returns all View labels defined for label GDTL

method.name: GetViewLabelsForClippingPlane
method.description: Returns all View labels defined for label ClippingPlaneL

method.name: GetViewLabelsForNote
method.description: Returns all View labels defined for label NoteL

method.name: GetViewLabelsForAnnotation
method.description: Returns all View labels defined for label AnnotationL

method.name: AddView
method.description: Adds a view definition to a View table and returns its label

method.name: GetRefShapeLabel
method.description: Returns shape labels defined for label theViewL Returns False if the theViewL is not in View table

method.name: GetRefGDTLabel
method.description: Returns GDT labels defined for label theViewL Returns False if the theViewL is not in View table

method.name: GetRefClippingPlaneLabel
method.description: Returns ClippingPlane labels defined for label theViewL Returns False if the theViewL is not in View table

method.name: GetRefNoteLabel
method.description: Returns Notes labels defined for label theViewL Returns False if the theViewL is not in View table

method.name: GetRefAnnotationLabel
method.description: Returns Annotation labels defined for label theViewL Returns False if the theViewL is not in View table

method.name: IsLocked
method.description: Returns true if the given View is marked as locked

method.name: Lock
method.description: Mark the given View as locked

method.name: Unlock
method.description: Unlock the given View

method.name: Set
method.description: Creates (if not exist) ViewTool.
